detail: SHIP-BLOCKER examples/platformer/src/App.tsx:45-46 calls sim.setPaused() inside a React setPaused updater. sim.setPaused synchronously notifies both useSyncExternalStore subscribers while App is rendering its state update, reproducibly emitting 'Cannot update a component (HUD) while rendering a different component (App)' on every Escape/P pause in dev. Compute the next pause state outside the updater/effect and notify the simulation after React commits.
